test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Because.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4 is Because.
 
• We can use because to explain why something is the way it is.
 
• Thus the correct answer is** Because.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uses of because- **
 
• We can begin an answer with **because + subject + verb**,
 
 
• ***we are late Because the traffic was very bad.***
 
• ***I ate a lot because I was hungry.***
